member.name: T:Jeninnet.Localization.Benchmarks.CacheDecoratorBenchmarks
member.summary: Decorator overhead (W2-01 caching layer): direct inner lookup versus the in-memory TTL decorator versus the distributed decorator over an in-memory stub. All three read the same warmed key, so the benchmarks time the steady-state hit path: provider call, cache-hit check, and distributed payload encode/decode. Short-run job keeps local iterations fast.
